descriptionChirho: The vertical measurement or dimensional height of a building, wall, pillar, altar, or other constructed object, consistently rendered with Arabic ارتفاع (irtifāʿ), Korean 높이 (nopi), and Swahili urefu.
The bodily height or physical build of a human or personified figure, consistently rendered with Arabic قامة (qāma), Korean 키 (ki), Hindi कद/काठी, and Swahili kimo.
